content: Researchers have investigated deeper LID models like bidirectional recurrent neural networks BIBREF23 or ensembles of recurrent neural networks BIBREF24. The latter is reported to achieve 95.12% in the DSL 2015 shared task. In these models text features can include character and word n-grams as well as informative character and word-level features learnt BIBREF25 from the training data. The neural methods seem to work well in tasks where more training data is available.
